title: Metrological Benchmarking of Random Quantum Circuits
summary: Random circuit sampling is a leading approach to demonstrating quantum computational advantage, but benchmarking noisy implementations through linear cross-entropy requires costly calculations of ideal output probabilities. We propose a metrological benchmark based on the response to controlled perturbations, characterized by quantum Fisher information (QFI). A relation between QFI and out-of-time-order correlators enables protocols with local or global control.
